captions_note: built with CAPTIONS=0 in a reel: the reel's own captions carry the words; the wall stays behind the speaker
in_a_reel: CLIPS is a folder of the buyer's own videos, at least 6, each 2 s or longer. No videos from the buyer = leave the effect out
leave GRADE to the reel; the wall needs a clean cutout. The slot needs about 2.1 s of one continuous shot
steps: put the buyer's videos in the slot's clips folder and set WORD (the word the first tile starts falling on) in the CLIP block
run build.py SAFE=1 CAPTIONS=0      # prints the beats and the snapshot times
run check.py      # frame count, work/check/sheet.jpg, phone copy

buyer_folder.name: clips
buyer_folder.what: the buyer's own videos (mp4 or mov: their reels or clips, each 2 s or longer). Only material they may show
